race.description: B & K Group Australia F&M (Bm78) Hcp
race.comment: SATONO JASMINE (9) made it three straight wins when she came to town and circled the field, showing a good turn of foot to get the job done over 1600m at Warwick Farm. Drops in weight and ready to tackle this stronger contest. FULL HAO (8) win record hardly excites but expecting a much stronger showing today with Tommy Berry taking over from a low gate. Just under a month between runs when she closed late for a tidy fifth over 1600m at Warwick Farm. Value prospect. AROHA STONE (1) confidence is high after she ploughed through the heavy going when well supported to score over 1400m at this track. Has further improvement and not without top-three claims. HORIZONS (13) gets back onto a firmer deck today and can make her presence felt.
